messages:
pager-bot: PAGER -> TP2: multi-gpu collective errors detected on cluster-prod-7. Severity: P1. Auto-escalation to oncall. Affected service: inference-runtime (real-time). Impact: increased latency, ~20% request failures, some customer sessions dropped. Trigger: nccl communicator errors across 3 nodes.

robin_oncall: I'm on it. Joining bridge. Which jobs are smoking? @alex_runtime can you grab the job IDs and node list?

alex_runtime: root:  job ids 9871, 9873, 9879. Nodes: prod-gpu-07a, prod-gpu-07b, prod-gpu-09a. Error seen: repeated NCCL fatal errors and intermittent CUDA XID_79 in container logs.

mira_ml: seeing the same on our monitoring dashboards — collective latency spikes then allreduce stalls around step 120.

sam_infra: grabbing kube events now, running: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector=status.phase=Running`

alex_runtime: paste of relevant container log excerpt:
```
2026-02-18T03:12:22Z runtime[pid=4211]: ncclCommInitRank failed: unhandled system error (ncclError 6)
2026-02-18T03:12:22Z runtime[pid=4211]: CUDA kernel error: XID 79, GPU 1, version 470.57
2026-02-18T03:12:23Z runtime[pid=4211]: ringSend: connection reset by peer
2026-02-18T03:12:24Z runtime[pid=4211]: communicator 0x7f9c3bf1d000: timeout during sync
```

robin_oncall: good logs. Does `nvidia-smi -q` on the nodes show ECC or thermal issues? @sam_infra can you ssh into prod-gpu-07b?

sam_infra: SSHed to 07b. nvidia-smi shows GPU 2 at 98% memory, no ECC errors, temps normal (75C). But I see process `runtime-container` using 98% of GPU mem and 100% SM on GPU1.

jordan_prod: looks like a memory pressure + cross-node timing issue. Could be KV cache eviction pattern triggers allreduce miscoordination. Any recent rollout? @alex_runtime any runtime changes rolled in last 24h?

alex_runtime: No recent rolling release to serving runtime. We did push a new quantization config to Dedicated pool yesterday but those jobs are on different clusters.

mira_ml: I can correlate the job shapes — TP2 jobs have uneven micro-batch padding; some ranks are spending extra time, causing rendezvous timeouts. Suggest we disable TP2 for queued jobs and fallback them to single-node TP1 or smaller world_size until we stabilize.

robin_oncall: Agreed. Immediate mitigations: 1) remove prod-gpu-07b from serving pool (drain), 2) trigger fallback routing for in-flight sessions to warm nodes, 3) restart runtime container on affected pods, 4) capture core dumps and NV logs for postmortem.

sam_infra: started drain on prod-gpu-07b via k8s: `kubectl cordon prod-gpu-07b && kubectl drain prod-gpu-07b --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

kevin_support: flagging customer-impact: two enterprise tenants reported degraded inference quality (timeouts) — support ticket ids: INC-45312, INC-45314. Notified customer success.

alex_runtime: restarting runtime pod runtime-9871 on prod-gpu-09a -> `kubectl rollout restart deployment/runtime -n inference` (targeted).

robin_oncall: while restart happens, can someone run NCCL tests on node pair 07a <-> 09a to verify fabric? Use `nccl-tests` quick allreduce with small buffers.

mira_ml: running a quick nccl test now (small vec): `./build/all_reduce_perf -b 8 -e 128 -f 2 -g 4`

mira_ml: test output (snippet):
```
# Using 4 GPUs
# Allreduce size 8B | time 0.00045s | alg ring | out-of-order errors: 0
# Allreduce size 128B | time 0.0121s | alg ring | timeout at step 3
```

alex_runtime: timeout reproduction on small buffers — suggests communicator resync issue not purely memory. I see `ncclCommAbort` in logs. Might be intermittent IB flaps between 07a and 09a.

sam_infra: checked switch logs, no link flaps reported. But I see large PCIe early errors on prod-gpu-07b for GPU1 around 03:12. Kernel shows `GPU reset due to fatal error` for pid 4211.

robin_oncall: plan: (A) keep node drained (07b) until we collect diagnostics, (B) route new TP2 jobs away from cross-node splits, (C) roll affected in-flight jobs back to TP1 or restart with world_size reduced, (D) collect `dmesg`, `nvidia-smi -q`, `kubectl logs --previous` and core dumps, (E) escalate to hardware team if PCIe errors persist.

jordan_prod: implementing routing rule now: fall back TP2->TP1 for sessions tagged `prod-realtime` so we don't break user-facing sessions. Will take ~60s to apply and warm nodes.

mira_ml: I pushed a temporary scheduler patch to avoid cross-node TP2 placement for the affected queue. Logging the policy change at infra:deploy/1289.

kevin_support: customer comms: sending short note to affected customers: "we're investigating elevated timeouts; we have mitigations in progress and will update in 30 minutes."

alex_runtime: collected `kubectl logs runtime-9871 -n inference --previous` and uploaded to S3 at s3://redwood-debug/3101234567/runtime-9871-prev.log. Also collected core dump at s3://redwood-debug/3101234567/core-runtime-9871.gz

sam_infra: ran `nvidia-bug-report.sh` on 07b and uploaded to the same bucket.

robin_oncall: who's taking the handoff after me? I'm going offline in ~45m. Need someone to own follow-up (postmortem + hardware check). @alex_runtime can you take postmortem and coordinate with hardware?

alex_runtime: I can take postmortem. Will collect traces, KV cache state, NCCL logs, and open a postmortem doc. Will also coordinate hardware check for PCIe error on GPU1.

mira_ml: I'll help with repro and adding regression tests to catch uneven step times causing rendezvous delays.

kevin_support: I'll keep customers updated and log impact in the incident tracker.

robin_oncall: thanks all. Summarize actions (for pager closure):
- drained prod-gpu-07b (no new allocations)
- applied routing fallback TP2->TP1 for prod-realtime queue
- restarted affected runtime pods and collected logs/core
- uploaded diagnostics to s3://redwood-debug/3101234567/
- assigned postmortem to alex_runtime, infra follow-up to sam_infra, ML regression to mira_ml
- customers notified (INC-45312, INC-45314)

robin_oncall: closing pager now, keeping incident channel open for follow-up. Handoff to alex_runtime (next oncall). :white_check_mark: 

alex_runtime: taking over. Will create incident doc and schedule 1h deep-dive in #incidents-postmortems. Thanks all.

kevin_support: noted — will attach customer logs and timeline to the incident doc when available.

mira_ml: quick note: add a synthetic check that runs small allreduce across nodes every 15m; alert if timeout > 200ms. That would've caught this earlier.

sam_infra: capturing ticket to check GPU1 on 07b and run hardware diagnostics (HARD-9876).

alex_runtime: last message before handoff: postmortem template will include timeline, root cause hypothesis (PCIe/GPU reset causing NCCL communicator aborts + uneven TP2 timing), mitigation actions, and long-term fixes (scheduler placement policy + nccl version pin + improved fallback).
